text:
I highly recommend PhysioX, a physiotherapy and Pilates studio in Chiang Mai. From the very first inquiry, their team responded quickly and professionally, making me feel well taken care of.

I came here with a shoulder injury caused by office syndrome, and the specialists at PhysioX gave me excellent advice and a clear rehabilitation plan. After six months of consistent physiotherapy and guided Pilates training, I’ve already seen remarkable improvements—even though my doctor originally estimated it might take two years to recover.

The studio has a warm, welcoming atmosphere, and the combination of physiotherapy and Pilates here not only helps with recovery but also supports long-term health and reduces the risk of future injuries. With qualified instructors like Teacher Looknok and a highly professional team, PhysioX has truly become one of my favorite places in Chiang Mai.❤️
